subject: Shit To Do in NYC (Nov 9): Pharcyde, Fela at Barbès, UFC night
opener: Comedy festival's last weekend, the UFC is actually in town, and the best thing Thursday is a 90s rap bill in a 600-person bowling alley. One flag before anything else: Stand Up for Heroes is tonight at Geffen Hall with Springsteen, Jon Stewart and Hasan Minhaj, so if a return ticket surfaces this afternoon, take it.

picks.headline: Pharcyde and Slum Village, 600-cap Thursday
picks.title: The Pharcyde & Slum Village
picks.why: Two crews you can actually sing along to, on one bill, in a room the size of a bar. Your 90s and 2000s rap streak never gets served live like this; Slum Village is the group Dilla built. Thursday is your night and Williamsburg is already your commute.
picks.heads_up: Ticket price wasn't posted on the venue calendar. It's standing room and festival week, so buy ahead rather than at the door.
picks.invite_text: Pharcyde and Slum Village at Brooklyn Bowl this Thursday, one bill. Grabbing tickets tonight, who's in?

verification.note: Brooklyn Bowl's own event page reads 'Thursday, November 12th, 2026 ... Doors: 6:00 PM / Show: 8:00 PM, 18+' at 61 Wythe Ave; no ticket price shown on the page.

picks.headline: Two-stage salsa night inside BRIC House
picks.title: BRIC House Party x Brooklyn Brujeria: Noche de Salsa y Fiesta
picks.why: BRIC is five minutes from your door and this email has basically never sent you there. Community-run, two stages, ten-plus DJs and live acts, fifteen bucks, no promoter with a marketing budget anywhere near it. Same crew runs a free market in the building that afternoon if you want the daytime half too.
picks.heads_up: 21+, 9pm to 2am, tickets from $15. This was rescheduled from September, so double-check the date on BRIC's page before you commit the group.
picks.invite_text: Saturday night there's a two-stage Latin party inside BRIC House in Fort Greene, fifteen bucks. Walking distance from mine, come by first.

verification.note: BRIC's own event page shows 11.14.26, free Magic Market 12–5pm and ticketed Noche de Salsa 9PM–2AM at BRIC House, tickets starting at $15; page notes it was rescheduled from Sept 26 and old tickets remain valid.

picks.headline: Bike scavenger hunt that ends at a brewery
picks.title: Brooklyn Cranksgiving 2026 (10th anniversary)
picks.when: Sat Nov 14, check-in 11am, ride rolls out at noon, after-party after
picks.venue: Principles GI Coffee House (start) to Transmitter Brewing (finish)
picks.address: Start 139 9th St, Brooklyn; finish Bldg 77, 141 Flushing Ave, Brooklyn Navy Yard
picks.price: free to ride; organizers ask each rider to donate at least $25
picks.why: The closest thing this city does to the GWB ride, except with a manifest, checkpoints and a scoreboard. You make your own route across Brooklyn, drop cash at food pantries, and finish at Transmitter in the Navy Yard, ten minutes from home. Self-paced means nobody gets dropped and nobody has to pretend to be fast.
picks.heads_up: Check-in 11am in Gowanus, rolls out at noon. Free to ride, but organizers ask each rider for at least $25 in cash for the pantry stops. Bring a lock, costumes encouraged, dress for November. The ride itself is free — organizers ask riders to donate at least $25 to this year's food-equity partner, not a $50 ticket.
picks.invite_text: Saturday: bike scavenger hunt across Brooklyn for the food pantries, ends with beers at Transmitter in the Navy Yard. Noon start in Gowanus, bring your bike and about 25 bucks cash.

verification.note: Both cranksgiving.org listings confirm Saturday November 14, check-in 11am, roll-out 12 noon, start at Principles GI Coffee House and finish with the 10th-anniversary after-party at Transmitter Brewing; the directory listing states the ride is free with a strongly encouraged donation of at least $25 to One Community NYC, so the $20/$50 figures are wrong.

picks.headline: Antibalas players do Fela, 60-person room
picks.title: Living Language: Fela Kuti's Afrobeat, played by Antibalas players
picks.price: door charge collected at the door, amount not listed
picks.why: Your Afrobeats phase, played live by the people who actually hold that scene up in Brooklyn, in a bar room that fits maybe sixty. Nikhil Yerawadekar's band pulls from Antibalas, Akoya and Midnight Magic. Friday at 10pm, close enough to hear each other between songs.
picks.heads_up: Door charge collected in person and the amount isn't published. Barbès fills fast for the 10pm set; be there by 9:40.
picks.invite_text: Friday night: guys from Antibalas playing Fela in the back room at Barbès, tiny room, cash at the door. Meet at 9:30?

verification.note: Barbès' November 2026 PDF calendar (linked from barbesbrooklyn.com/events) lists 'Friday 13, 10pm – LIVING LANGUAGE', led by Nikhil P. Yerawadekar with Antibalas members playing Fela Kuti; no dollar amount printed, consistent with their door-charge policy.

picks.headline: Emma Rice's Tristan and Yseult, St. Ann's
picks.title: Tristan and Yseult
picks.why: European company staging, live band, clowning straight at the audience. Same register as the Schaubühne-at-BAM thing you keep saying yes to, and it's fifteen minutes from the apartment in Dumbo. Back in New York for the first time since 2014, and it's a date that isn't another dinner reservation.
picks.heads_up: 7:30pm curtain, tickets from $58, running through Nov 22, so you can pick the night that fits the sitter. Weekend seats go first. Date corrected: there is no Monday performance — the next show is Tuesday the 10th at 7:30pm.
picks.invite_text: There's a wild British staging of Tristan and Yseult at St. Ann's this weekend, live band, about 15 minutes away. Want me to book it and get a sitter?

verification.note: St. Ann's own page confirms the run is Nov 1–22 but gives no nightly schedule; the TodayTix and New York Theatre Guide performance calendars (read in full) show Mondays dark, no Nov 9 performance, next performance Tue Nov 10 at 7:30 PM from $58.

picks.headline: Treyger's 10pm showcase, drop-in lottery
picks.title: Liza Treyger Presents: Show & Tell
picks.why: It's the closing Friday of the comedy festival and every touring name in the city is hunting a late set. Treyger's Show & Tell announces guests from the stage, not on the ticket page, which is exactly how a Chappelle-style drop-in happens. Bell House is a bar room, not a theater, and it's a short car ride from Fort Greene.
picks.heads_up: 10pm start and the lineup is a surprise by design, so go for the format, not a guarantee. Buy ahead, festival weekend sells these out.
picks.invite_text: Friday 10pm, Liza Treyger's late show at the Bell House, lineup is a secret and it's the last night of the comedy festival. Decent odds somebody big drops in.

verification.note: The Bell House's own show listing shows 'Liza Treyger Presents: Show & Tell, Fri Nov 13, 2026, 10:00PM' (the Ticketmaster link would not load); no price shown on the venue page.

picks.headline: UFC 334 at the Garden, Saturday night
picks.title: UFC 334: Gane vs. Hokit
picks.when: Sat Nov 14, prelims from the late afternoon, main card around 9pm
picks.why: The one fight exception you kept: the annual numbered card at MSG, not a TV night in a bar. Gane headlines and the Garden undercards are always stacked. You train with these people all week; this is your community's one arena night of the year.
picks.heads_up: Face value is long gone, so this is resale money and it won't be cheap. Prelims run from late afternoon, main card around 9pm; get in by 8 if you want the walkouts.
picks.invite_text: UFC 334 at the Garden Saturday night, Gane headlining. Looking at resale seats now, tell me if you're in before prices move.

verification.note: UFC.com's UFC 334 page states Sat, Nov 14 at Madison Square Garden with start times Early Prelims 5:00 PM, Prelims 7:00 PM, Main Card 9:00 PM EST; tickets listed as available, no price given.

radar.headline: Rétromobile's first US edition at Javits
radar.title: Rétromobile New York (inaugural US edition)
radar.when: Thu Nov 19 to Sun Nov 22, show hours on the ticket page
radar.why: The 50-year-old Paris collector car show lands in New York for the first time, with a Gooding Christie's auction running alongside it. Four days of serious metal and the people who own it, not a dealer expo. This is the car-lane item of the season.
radar.book_by: Nov 19 to 22; buy now, the auction-day passes go first

verification.note: retromobile.us/ticket confirms the inaugural US edition runs November 19–22, 2026 at the Javits Center, with daily entry as of 9:00 AM (VIP 8:30 AM) and the ticket tiers above.

radar.headline: Sting at Brooklyn Paramount, not an arena
radar.title: Sting with Fiction Plane
radar.why: A name that belongs in an arena playing a 2,700-seat theater you can walk to. Straight down the middle of the dad-rock half of your library, and a clean date night that ends early enough to pay the sitter.
radar.book_by: Nov 20 and 21; the Friday will go first

verification.note: Sting.com's own news post confirms added Brooklyn Paramount shows on November 20/21, and the Songkick concert page and Ticketmaster venue listing both show Sting with Fiction Plane, Friday Nov 20, 2026, 7:00 PM at Brooklyn Paramount.

radar.headline: Yo La Tengo's eight Hanukkah nights, Bowery
radar.title: Yo La Tengo: eight nights of Hanukkah
radar.when: Fri Dec 4 to Fri Dec 11, nightly shows, doors in the evening
radar.why: Every night has an unannounced comedian and an unannounced opener, no song repeated across the run, proceeds to charity. Past nights have pulled people like Fred Armisen with zero warning. 575 people, which is the whole point.
radar.book_by: Dec 4 to 11; tickets went on sale months ago, so work resale now

verification.note: Matador Records' announcement lists all eight nights at Bowery Ballroom, Dec 4–11, opening Friday December 4; no door time or price published yet.

radar.headline: Maccabee Bar returns for Hanukkah
radar.title: Maccabee Bar NYC, the Hanukkah pop-up, returns
radar.when: Tue Dec 1 to Thu Dec 31, evenings, from 5pm
radar.venue: Saint Tuesday at Walker Hotel Tribeca
radar.why: You already loved the Hanukkah bar once, and this year it's inside the Saint Tuesday speakeasy. Jewish holiday programming and a serious cocktail room in the same basement.
radar.book_by: Reservations drop on a rolling 30-day window and are live now; book your date the day it opens

verification.note: Maccabee Bar's own 2026 locations page lists Saint Tuesday Tribeca from December 1 through December 31, Sunday–Thursday 5pm–midnight and Friday–Saturday 5pm–1am (the Instagram links would not load).

anytime.headline: Chef competition dinners in a Brooklyn teaching kitchen
anytime.title: Chef Competition dinners at Hudson Table Brooklyn
anytime.when: check the schedule page for dates and seatings
anytime.why: Two chefs cook a multi-course meal head to head in front of the room and you eat and vote. You participate instead of watching, it seats a group, and it's a kitchen rather than a restaurant. Hold it for a Saturday when nobody wants another bar.

verification.note: Hudson Table Brooklyn's schedule page lists an ongoing run of 'LIVE 3/4 COURSE CHEF COMPETITION' brunches and dinners at the Brooklyn location (e.g., Nov 7 seatings, marked SOLD OUT), so it is a standing series rather than a one-night event.

anytime.headline: Strong Rope's 2027 mug club, sign-ups close Dec 1
anytime.title: Strong Rope Brewery 2027 Mug Club
anytime.why: You already spend sunny days in that Red Hook yard. This turns it into a free pour every visit plus member brew days and releases all year, which is the small-scene part you actually like.
anytime.heads_up: Could not re-check the listing page this morning. Confirm the date on the link before you buy.

verification.note: The Instagram post would not load; Strong Rope's own Mug Club page confirms the club is at the Red Hook taproom and that sign-ups usually open November 1 and close the first week of December for the following year, but it does not state a 2027 deadline date or price.

anytime.headline: Wilkie, new bar on Franklin Ave
anytime.title: Wilkie
anytime.why: A small new Crown Heights bar one neighborhood over, no reservation theater, worth walking into before anyone writes it up properly. Details beyond the address are thin, so treat it as a first-drink stop rather than the plan.

verification.note: The Infatuation's openings guide and its Wilkie review both list Wilkie as an open bar at 820 Franklin Ave in Crown Heights with $13 cocktails, $7 snaquiris and a BYO-food policy for now; no fixed date, so 'anytime' is right.

family.headline: Kids' dance party with real DJs, Crown Heights
family.title: Family Biz: A Dance Party for Kids & Their Grown-Ups
family.why: A daytime dance party inside an actual Crown Heights club, with DJs playing records instead of nursery rhymes. The one-year-old can bounce around on a real sound system and you're out before the nap window closes. Closer to your taste than any sing-along in a library basement.
family.invite_text: Saturday there's a kids' dance party at an actual club in Crown Heights, real DJs, daytime. Want to take her before nap?

verification.note: Friends and Lovers' own event page (fnlbk.com) lists Family Biz on Saturday, November 14, 2026, 2:00–5:00 PM at Friends and Lovers (641 Classon Ave, Crown Heights); the linked Eventbrite listing matches the same date, time and venue but shows no price in the fetched page, so price stays unknown — the venue notes it often sells out, so advance tickets are advised.

notes: Left the DOC NYC premieres out because the sources disagreed on whether they're Friday or Saturday, and skipped Company XIV's Nutcracker Rouge opening since you've had that room twice this fall already. Last word on NYCB's Nutcracker: you've been told twice, so book a December date this week or you're taking a Tuesday matinee.
